'''Sun Generators''' were a type of technology used by the [[Eternal Empire]] of [[Zakuul]]. Massive [[Power generator/Legends|power generator]] towers protecting miniature [[Star/Legends|stars]], Sun Generators provided power to the technology of the Eternal Empire. They powered the [[Eternal Fleet warship]]s, [[Star Fortress]]es and the [[Spire (Zakuul)|Spire]] on Zakuul. Due to their massive power output, the technology was dangerous to misuse. An overloaded Sun Generator was capable of causing a catastrophic destruction to multiple [[City/Legends|city]] blocks, its blast contained enough power to vaporize the entire Star Fortress.<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Sun Generators appear in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Fallen Empire]]'' expansion, released with Update 4.0.
